title: THE CAREER LEADERBOARD ON THE RUN CARD
why: His order of 2026-10-15: career mode should have a leaderboard shown after every match, built into the existing UI. After a CAREER extraction or death the run card now has a second step in the same card, no second window: the ledger, then the haul reveal, then the LEADERBOARD. The continue control reads LEADERBOARD first; a click on it, ENTER or the controller A opens the board, and there it is LOG RUN AND RETURN again. ESC, TAB and the controller B still close the card and log the run at once, from either step. The board is the same one the Undercroft will open: his twenty best runs by raid score with rank, score, outcome, sector, time and date, this run in teal climbing into its place while its score counts up, RANK number OF total on top, a NEW PERSONAL BEST plate for a number one, and a pinned row under the list when the run did not make the top twenty. An abandon is not a run and has no step. Each player window shows its own save.
now: A career run card now ends on your leaderboard, with the run you just played climbing into its rank.
